name: scheduled-no-past-items
goal: A past-due tracker item is launched at its due time or shown as Running, Queued or Blocked, never as Scheduled

evidence: Hub Home listed every unfinished item with a due time as Scheduled, including ETAs and past times, and overdue rows filled the 120 cap; the general due scheduler was off unless a launch config set due:true.
No test built the schedule from past or in-progress items; scheduler tests passed scheduleDue/enabled by hand, so the default host config and ordinary spoke grants were never exercised.
